chain.text:
Estate: 18 ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc), clay/flint. ~62,000 bottles/year; 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail cut ~20% on western plots.

Established: organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023, earliest certification 2026 (three compliant years). Exports 41%, mainly Belgium/Japan; Japanese importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/L.

Rule: no irrigation on western plots (2021 trial lowered acidity below importer's limit). Harvest dates set by sugar/acidity over three consecutive mornings. Tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.

Failures: 2022 tank 4 controller drifted 3°C, batch sold in bulk, €11,000 loss; now calibrated pre-harvest with second probe. 2023 label error, 900 bottles recalled; proofs need two signatures.

Open: lighter bottles (2025 proposal, importer unconfirmed, no cost comparison). Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years old, yields down 30% in five years.
